name: GA4 MCP Server
description: Enables interaction with Google Analytics 4 to manage accounts, run standard or realtime reports, and validate event parameters. It supports dual authentication methods and integrates with GTM for end-to-end data collection orchestration.

rawRecord.description: Enables interaction with Google Analytics 4 to manage accounts, run standard or realtime reports, and validate event parameters. It supports dual authentication methods and integrates with GTM for end-to-end data collection orchestration.

GA4_CLIENT_ID.description: OAuth client ID from the Google Cloud Console.

GA4_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: OAuth access token for Google Analytics 4 API authentication.

GA4_CLIENT_SECRET.description: OAuth client secret from the Google Cloud Console.

GA4_REFRESH_TOKEN.description: OAuth refresh token for Google Analytics 4 API authentication.

GA4_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON.description: Google Analytics 4 Service Account credentials provided as a raw JSON string.

GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS.description: Path to the Google Analytics 4 Service Account JSON credentials file.
